artefact: outcome (policy) overlay — RULE-BASED notation (source of truth)
status: finalised (R2; Marc greenlit 2026-07-23; converged after 4 adversarial cross-examination rounds, ~90 agents)
value_semantics: overlay_v(src->dst) in [0,1] = given the dispatched verb at src returned verdict v, the conditional likelihood of dst as the next move (0=won't happen, 1=most likely next).
coverage: COMPLETE directed tactic-pair space: 210 = 15*14 (no self-loops). Corpus-AGNOSTIC: every ordered pair is weighted from declared knowledge, so a different CTI/corpus that introduces a new edge is already covered. Which pairs actually ROUTE mass is a base/net property (base=0 => no routing), NOT an overlay property. Self-loop 'retry same tactic' is handled by the stepping layer's bounded-retry, not the overlay.
authoring: CTI-INDEPENDENT declared knowledge only: kill-chain bands + capability-enablement + foothold-dependency. Values are RULE-GENERATED (first-match-wins); rationale is stored ONCE per rule, never per pair.

success_rules.rationale: success at the source confers the capability/position the destination needs next (enables set)
success_rules.scrutiny: rounds 0-3; enables sets = MITRE tactic semantics + DFIR get-in/spread sequences. C2-hub subset (c2->{cred,privesc,persist}) is the weakest member, conf~56, Marc-ratified keep-with-principle.
changelog: R1/R2: +enables initial-access->command-and-control, privilege-escalation->persistence, credential-access->persistence, and the C2-hub set (Marc decision-1: keep with inclusion principle).

success_rules.rationale: kill-chain progress to a later band, not a specifically-enabled next move
success_rules.scrutiny: kill-chain structural prior; unchallenged across rounds.

success_rules.rationale: same-phase sibling move — plausible but not the enabled next step
success_rules.scrutiny: sibling-retry; declared judgement. Backward>lateral ordering is a Marc-owned modelling prior.

success_rules.rationale: regress to a pre-intrusion (band-0) tactic after success — very unlikely
success_rules.scrutiny: 'do not re-recon after succeeding deeper' — unchallenged.

success_rules.rationale: regression is unlikely once the step succeeded
success_rules.scrutiny: 'back to the drawing board'; the failure side is the declared-judgement tier by construction (AARs rarely record post-failure behaviour).

failure_rules.rationale: initial-access failed => no foothold, so a foothold-dependent destination is out of reach
failure_rules.scrutiny: R1 flagged the flat 0.1 self-cancels against base(ia->execution); R2 validated on composed nets: recon-bridge dominance 50%->83% on both sparse profiles.
changelog: R2: 0.1 -> 0.02 (foothold-unreachability; the intended recon bridge must dominate IA-failure).

failure_rules.rationale: reconnaissance failed (nothing found) => breaking in is weaker, but not impossible
failure_rules.scrutiny: recon-fail weakens but does not ban breaking in; unchanged.

failure_rules.rationale: reconnaissance failed => a deep post-intrusion move is implausible with no foothold
failure_rules.scrutiny: same foothold-unreachability defect as the IA gate, on the recon row.

failure_rules.rationale: post-intrusion failure falling all the way back to a pre-foothold tactic is a minor, not modal, regress
failure_rules.scrutiny: R1 red-team (Opus): failure side lacked the success side's pre-intrusion damper; internal-coherence fix. Validated: deep->prep regressions now ~0.02-0.05 routed.
changelog: R1: NEW rule. post-intrusion backward->pre-foothold 0.9 -> 0.25 (mirror the success guard). Exempts the initial-access->reconnaissance bridge (source is pre-foothold).

failure_rules.rationale: re-running code against a held foothold is a forward-level retry-continuation, not a penalised regress
failure_rules.scrutiny: R1/R2 most-corroborated residual: flat 0.9 routed 15-41% to regress-to-execution. R2 fix halves it (exec-sink 2.752->1.598). KNOWN benign quirk: pure_steal defense-impairment->execution rises 0.5->0.583 (sparse-out-set renorm: sibling damped harder). Round 4 (stepwise) in progress.
changelog: R2: NEW rule. backward->execution 0.9 -> 0.35 (re-running code on a held foothold is a forward-level continuation, not a penalised regress). Decoupled from enables.

failure_rules.rationale: fall back / regress — the natural 'back to the drawing board' move on failure
failure_rules.scrutiny: 'back to the drawing board'; the failure side is the declared-judgement tier by construction (AARs rarely record post-failure behaviour).

failure_rules.rationale: try a same-phase sibling tactic — an alternative route to the same objective
failure_rules.scrutiny: sibling-retry; declared judgement. Backward>lateral ordering is a Marc-owned modelling prior.

failure_rules.rationale: forward after failure from a held foothold: a retry-then-advance is possible but not modal
failure_rules.scrutiny: retry-then-advance from a held foothold; default forward-on-failure (35 pairs).
changelog: R1: confirmed 0.35 is the DEFAULT (35 pairs), 0.30 the exception (prep sources).

failure_rules.rationale: forward after failure from a pre-foothold stage is unlikely (the dependency did not land)
failure_rules.scrutiny: forward-on-failure from a pre-foothold stage; the dependency did not land.

provenance_tiers.corpus-grounded: value derived from CTI/corpus data (does not apply here — the overlay is CTI-independent by design)
provenance_tiers.attested-pattern: the BEHAVIOUR is documented in reports/literature (e.g. get-in/spread sequences, perimeter retry loops); the exact MAGNITUDE is declared
provenance_tiers.declared-judgement: reasoned from kill-chain + foothold logic; not attested (incident reports rarely record post-failure behaviour)

ledger_meta.review_history: R0 initial cross-exam (13 agents) -> red-team re-run -> R1 branching (36) -> R2 fold + composed-net validation -> R3 decision round (10; verdict 85%) -> R4 stepwise simulation (24; in progress)
ledger_meta.reproducibility: values are rule-generated; generator reproduces the committed table 0/123 before edits (deterministic, not post-hoc)
ledger_meta.maintenance: each adversarial round appends per-rule scrutiny + changelog. R0-R4 complete; FINALISED at R2 (Marc greenlit 2026-07-23). The residual 82%->95% gap is the dissertation defence/write-up, not value uncertainty (finetune synthesis returned an empty change set).
